about_the_game:
Hello hackers from around the world!
Super Hack Attack is a multiplayer puzzle-combat game set in a not-so-distant future, where ferocious coding battles decide who becomes the most prolific hacker on Earth. Fight friends in local and online frenzy matches—dexterity and strategy are your path to victory.

Your goal is to ban your opponent by destroying their Network using a combination of Malware, Special Programs, Defensive/Offensive Maneuvers, and powerful Super Software.
Each playable character features its own backstory, motivations, and signature Super Software. Battles unfold across varied stages, each with distinct characteristics—number of PCs, connections, and hazards—so you can leverage every aspect of the arena.

Demo Content
Game Modes: 1 vs 1 and 2 vs 2.

Playable Characters:
Obskuria – Spam Bot
Hitsune – Input
Time Hound – Overheat
Miss Toaster – Hevboard

Available Maps: Factory, Moss Park, Library.

Software Modes:
Random or Manual selection: Optical Fiber, Firewall, Short Circuit, Troyan, Mirror Shield.

Customizable Options:
Difficulty: Very Easy, Easy, Normal, Hard, Very Hard.
Speed: Virus Speed.
Lives: Storage (Hit Points).

Music Tracks: W.A.R.S, 404, SW4NSONG, CATS IN THE JAR, PSYCHO SHADOW.

Post-Match Stats: Malwares, Combos, Time, Mistakes, Parries.

Gear up for a high-energy cyber showdown where every input matters and a sharp plan can flip the fate of the Network.
